mapper.sql: (SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_fee) AS refund_fee FROM aftersales_refund a WHERE refund_status IN ('AUDIT_SUCCESS', 'SUCCESS', 'CHANGE') AND order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM orders_normal_orders WHERE order_type = 'normal' AND order_class = 'community') GROUP BY order_id)
mapper.select:
SELECT rel.chief_id AS chiefId, SUM(o.total_fee - COALESCE(r.refund_fee, 0)) AS totalFee, SUM(FLOOR((o.total_fee - COALESCE(r.refund_fee, 0)) * rel.rebate_ratio / 100)) AS rebateTotal FROM orders_normal_orders o LEFT JOIN community_order_rel_activity rel ON o.order_id = rel.order_id LEFT JOIN
r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.order_type = 'normal' AND o.order_class = 'community' AND o.pay_status = 'PAYED' AND o.order_status != 'CANCEL' AND o.company_id = #{companyId} AND rel.chief_id IN
#{cid}
GROUP BY rel.chief_id

SELECT rel.chief_id AS chiefId, SUM(FLOOR((o.total_fee - COALESCE(r.refund_fee, 0)) * rel.rebate_ratio / 100)) AS closeRebate FROM orders_normal_orders o LEFT JOIN community_order_rel_activity rel ON o.order_id = rel.order_id LEFT JOIN
r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.order_type = 'normal' AND o.order_class = 'community' AND o.pay_status = 'PAYED' AND o.order_status != 'CANCEL' AND o.company_id = #{companyId} AND o.order_auto_close_aftersales_time IS NOT NULL AND o.order_auto_close_aftersales_time < #{nowSeconds} AND rel.chief_id IN
#{cid}
GROUP BY rel.chief_id

SELECT (SELECT SUM(FLOOR((o.total_fee - COALESCE(r.refund_fee, 0)) * rel.rebate_ratio / 100)) FROM orders_normal_orders o LEFT JOIN community_order_rel_activity rel ON o.order_id = rel.order_id LEFT JOIN
r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.order_type = 'normal' AND o.order_class = 'community' AND o.pay_status = 'PAYED' AND o.order_status != 'CANCEL' AND o.company_id = #{companyId} AND o.distributor_id = #{distributorId}) AS rebate_total, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(money), 0) FROM community_chief_cash_withdrawal WHERE status = 'apply' AND company_id = #{companyId} AND distributor_id = #{distributorId}) AS freeze_cash_withdrawal_rebate, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(money), 0) FROM community_chief_cash_withdrawal WHERE status = 'success' AND company_id = #{companyId} AND distributor_id = #{distributorId}) AS payed_rebate, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT chief_id) FROM community_chief_cash_withdrawal WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND distributor_id = #{distributorId}) AS apply_chief_num
